title: 7S.2c LEADER raw-entity collision index fast slice
scope: Continue the 7S.2c LEADER preflight scratch census after cross-family collision indexing was narrowed
Avoid retaining every raw entity handle when only collisions with annotation targets affect the result
Preserve cross-block ordering by collecting all typed annotation targets before scanning raw events

method.kind: Local source audit and existing generated ASCII/Binary LEADER selector
method.limitations: The generated selector verifies duplicate raw records colliding with a typed target and destination preservation, but does not measure process memory or qualify producer interoperability. Git metadata is read-only in this workspace; the slice remains uncommitted.

details: Collect typed entity identities and all LEADER annotation handles first, then scan raw entity events and retain only valid raw handles present in the annotation target set.
Skip raw-handle collision scanning if there are no annotation targets; keep nonzero/non-sentinel filtering and raw-collision rejection unchanged.
